tasks.label: Benchmark sequential build comparison
args: if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw1=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build; $code1=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw1.Stop(); $sec1=[math]::Round($sw1.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Write-Output "BENCH_RESULT script=build seconds=$sec1 exit=$code1"; if ($code1 -ne 0) { exit $code1 }; if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw2=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build:astro:fast; $code2=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw2.Stop(); $sec2=[math]::Round($sw2.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Write-Output "BENCH_RESULT script=build:astro:fast seconds=$sec2 exit=$code2"; if ($code2 -ne 0) { exit $code2 }; $delta=[math]::Round($sec1-$sec2,2); $pct=[math]::Round((($sec1-$sec2)/$sec1)*100,2); Write-Output "BENCH_RESULT delta_seconds=$delta improvement_pct=$pct"

tasks.label: Benchmark to file
args: $results='benchmark-results.txt'; $buildLog='benchmark-build.log'; $fastLog='benchmark-astro-fast.log'; Remove-Item $results,$buildLog,$fastLog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw1=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build *> $buildLog; $code1=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw1.Stop(); $sec1=[math]::Round($sw1.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Add-Content $results "BENCH_RESULT script=build seconds=$sec1 exit=$code1"; if ($code1 -ne 0) { exit $code1 }; if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw2=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build:astro:fast *> $fastLog; $code2=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw2.Stop(); $sec2=[math]::Round($sw2.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Add-Content $results "BENCH_RESULT script=build:astro:fast seconds=$sec2 exit=$code2"; if ($code2 -ne 0) { exit $code2 }; $delta=[math]::Round($sec1-$sec2,2); $pct=[math]::Round((($sec1-$sec2)/$sec1)*100,2); Add-Content $results "BENCH_RESULT delta_seconds=$delta improvement_pct=$pct"

tasks.label: Benchmark to file retry
args: $results='bench_results.txt'; $buildLog='bench_build.log'; $fastLog='bench_fast.log'; Remove-Item -Path $results -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path $buildLog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path $fastLog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw1=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build *> $buildLog; $code1=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw1.Stop(); $sec1=[math]::Round($sw1.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Add-Content -Path $results -Value "BENCH_RESULT script=build seconds=$sec1 exit=$code1"; if ($code1 -ne 0) { exit $code1 }; if (Test-Path .netlify) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .netlify }; if (Test-Path .astro) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .astro }; $sw2=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); npm run build:astro:fast *> $fastLog; $code2=$LASTEXITCODE; $sw2.Stop(); $sec2=[math]::Round($sw2.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2); Add-Content -Path $results -Value "BENCH_RESULT script=build:astro:fast seconds=$sec2 exit=$code2"; if ($code2 -ne 0) { exit $code2 }; $delta=[math]::Round($sec1-$sec2,2); $pct=[math]::Round((($sec1-$sec2)/$sec1)*100,2); Add-Content -Path $results -Value "BENCH_RESULT delta_seconds=$delta improvement_pct=$pct"

args: $urls = @('https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/Midwest','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/Northeast','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/South','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/West','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Painterly-Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/International','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Painterly-Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/Midwest','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Painterly-Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/Northeast','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Painterly-Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/South','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Painterly-Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Location/West'); foreach($u in $urls){ $headers = curl.exe -s -I $u; $status = ($headers | Select-String '^HTTP/' | Select-Object -First 1).Line; $loc = ($headers | Select-String '^location:' | Select-Object -First 1).Line; if (-not $loc) { $loc = 'location: (none)' }; Write-Output "$status | $u | $loc" }

tasks.label: Spot check live sitemap URLs
args: $pages=@('https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Architecture/Gallery/i-fszvgmq','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Transportation/Cars/i-c8SFXzH','https://www.k4studios.com/Galleries/Fine-Art-Photography/Landscapes/By-Theme/Color/i-4S3C7Hx'); $imgs=@('https://www.k4studios.com/img/i-fszvgmq/l','https://www.k4studios.com/img/i-c8SFXzH/l','https://www.k4studios.com/img/i-4S3C7Hx/l'); foreach($u in $imgs){ $h=curl.exe -s -I $u; $s=($h|Select-String '^HTTP/'|Select-Object -First 1).Line; Write-Output "IMG $u | $s" }; foreach($u in $pages){ $h=curl.exe -s -I $u; $s=($h|Select-String '^HTTP/'|Select-Object -First 1).Line; $html=curl.exe -s $u; $canon=($html|Select-String '<link rel="canonical" href="[^"]+"'|Select-Object -First 1).Matches.Value; Write-Output "PAGE $u | $s | $canon" }

tasks.label: Run live spot checks to file
Audit image caption lengths
args: $files = Get-ChildItem public -Filter 'image-sitemap-*.xml'; $lengths = @(); foreach ($f in $files) { $content = Get-Content $f.FullName -Raw; $matches = [regex]::Matches($content, '<image:caption>(.*?)</image:caption>', 'Singleline'); foreach ($m in $matches) { $t = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Replace($m.Groups[1].Value, '\s+', ' ').Trim(); $lengths += $t.Length } }; $max = 0; if ($lengths.Count -gt 0) { $max = ($lengths | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum }; $over900 = ($lengths | Where-Object { $_ -gt 900 }).Count; $over800 = ($lengths | Where-Object { $_ -gt 800 }).Count; Write-Output "FILES=$($files.Count)"; Write-Output "CAPTIONS=$($lengths.Count)"; Write-Output "MAX=$max"; Write-Output "OVER_900=$over900"; Write-Output "OVER_800=$over800"

tasks.label: Quick sitemap caption audit py
args: import glob, re; files=sorted(glob.glob('public/image-sitemap-*.xml')); text='\n'.join(open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() for f in files); caps=re.findall(r'<image:caption>(.*?)</image:caption>', text, re.S); lens=[len(' '.join(c.split())) for c in caps]; print('FILES',len(files)); print('CAPTIONS',len(lens)); print('MAX',max(lens) if lens else 0); print('OVER_900',sum(1 for n in lens if n>900)); print('OVER_800',sum(1 for n in lens if n>800))
